items.text: Release states from active packs recorded as receipts up to 'operating' (or the pack's terminal state)
Every alert was test-fired into the real channel once; each links a runbook of at least three lines
Induced-failure drill: one failure was caused on purpose and diagnosed from telemetry alone (or the owner waived it)
Advisory checklists from active packs were shown to the owner (advisory only — the owner's decision is final either way)
Ops handoff doc exists: how to see status, how to stop it, who is paged, where receipts live

redFlags: A runbook that says 'investigate' without a first command
Ship declared while release-state receipts stop before the terminal state

rationalizations.excuse: We can wire monitoring after launch
rationalizations.reality: The first incident happens before monitoring exists in every project that says this. Alerts are part of the deliverable.
